relationships.subject: miR-199b-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-199b-3p specifically targeted and inhibited MeCP2 expression by directly interacting with its 3'-UTR sequence

relationships.subject: MeCP2 in hippocampal NSCs
relationships.evidence_quote: MeCP2 overexpression with AAV‐DIO‐Mecp2 injection accompanied by tamoxifen administration was able to restore the AHN level in the ventral DG of mice on day 25 after the SNI surgery

relationships.subject: MeCP2 in hippocampal NSCs
relationships.evidence_quote: MeCP2 overexpression in hippocampal NSCs was able to alleviate the depression‐like behaviors of these mice

relationships.subject: chronic neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Both miR‐199b‐3p and miR‐200c‐3p were prominently upregulated in the DG of mice with chronic pain

relationships.subject: miR-199b-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting the pro‐depressant role of miR‐199b‐3p in hippocampal NSCs of mice with chronic pain

key_findings: Chronic pain raises miR-199b-3p in hippocampal NSCs, which suppresses MeCP2, inhibits adult hippocampal neurogenesis and drives depression-like behavior.
MeCP2 overexpression in NSCs restores neurogenesis and alleviates pain-comorbid depression-like behaviors.
